name: M5.QuotientCharacter.finite_fibre_count
statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → AdjoinRoot P) (z : AdjoinRoot P), (∑ lam : M5.Character.BinaryVector P.natDegree, M5.QuotientCharacter.value P hP lam z * ∑ u : Fin n, M5.QuotientCharacter.value P hP lam (f u)) = (2 : ℤ) ^ P.natDegree * ((Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => f u = z)).card : ℤ)
queries: AdjoinRoot power basis coordinates linear equivalence
guidance: Apply imported M5.Character.finite_fibre_count to coordinates ∘ f and coordinates z. Identify the filter predicates via linear-equivalence injectivity. Reuse the accepted count directly: this target is independent of the other new targets. Includes n=0 and P=1; there is no division or positive-degree assumption. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve the exact target.
